opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed informa pau-peris denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioner is allowed until July 20, 1992, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

Justice Blackmun and Justice Stevens would deny the petition for writ of certiorari.
